[0;32mUsage: [0m[0;33mhm restart [-t seconds] [service...]
[0m[0;32mExample: [0m[0;33mhm restart phpfpm
[0m[0;32mDescription:[0m Restart docker services
[0;32mOptions:
[0m   [0;33m[-t|--timeout]  [0m Seconds each container is given to stop before it is killed
[0;32mArguments:
[0m   [0;33m<service-name>  [0mRestart specific container of the service-name.
